checks.name: Workspace component tests (customer web activity, cook insights)
Browser workflows on the real local stack (cook Insights tab in the layout and axe sweep)

scenario_results.observed: ActivityInsightsIntegrationTest on PostgreSQL (red first: 3 of 4 failed): ten refreshes by one visitor count one impression, one meal view, one kitchen view and one add-to-cart; a second visitor adds one view; a declared crawler and unknown subjects are not counted (202 either way); malformed kinds and visitor ids are refused; two kitchens are counted separately; the table stores only day, kind, subject, kitchen and a 32-byte keyed hash, never the visitor id. The cook report for two completed orders, one cancelled order and a paid refund of 2500 shows quotes 3, placed 3, completed 2, cancelled 1, repeat customers 1, portions 20 offered and 2 taken, gross 20000, refunds 2500, known net 17500, definitions including NET_IS_NOT_PROFIT, and no profit, margin, sponsor, customer or phone field; the other kitchen's report shows 0. A customer gets 403, an anonymous caller 401, a kitchenId parameter cannot select another kitchen, and a window over 366 days is refused. Discovery has no sponsored, promoted or advert data.

findings: MB-054 at a89151f. Self-review, not independent review.

Limits: a bot that rotates visitor ids on every request is bounded only by the request size (50 events), not by the per-visitor cap; edge rate limiting is a preview/deployment control. Native apps do not send activity yet (web only). Search/filter context is not recorded. Retention of activity rows is decided under O06 (no deletion job yet). Deposit refunds reported by kitchens (order_payment REFUNDED) are not in the refunds figure, which counts paid or verified refunds from the finance workflow.
No sponsored ranking, campaign, billing or profit figure exists (Stage 3-4 not started; owner go required).
